system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

As part of casting a jutsu with a nature release keyword that can inflict an Elemental condition, you may spend 1 Superiority Die. When you do, it inflicts additional ranks of the condition (If able) if the conditions to inflict the condition are met (Failed save, successful attack, etc.) equal to half the result of the Superiority Die.
